quarterly_data.signal: NextEra Energy's 10-Q: estimated capital expenditures as of September 30, 2026 for the remainder of 2026 through 2030 include new wind projects and repowering of existing wind projects totaling approximately 3,486 MW, new solar projects (including solar plus battery storage) totaling approximately 15,877 MW and primarily battery storage projects totaling approximately 8,237 MW, each with related transmission. NEER's contracts primarily for the purchase of wind turbines, wind towers, solar modules, batteries and transmission equipment and related construction and development activities, and for the supply of uranium and the conversion, enrichment and fabrication of nuclear fuel (expiration dates through 2033), carry approximately $10.0 billion of commitments included in those estimates.
quarterly_data.figure: remainder of 2026 through 2030 capex estimates include ~3,486 MW wind, ~15,877 MW solar, ~8,237 MW battery storage; ~$10.0 billion NEER commitments for equipment, related construction and nuclear fuel

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditures, independent power and other investments and nuclear fuel purchases for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $27,554 million versus $19,328 million a year earlier: FPL $8,322 million (new generation $3,010 million vs $2,411 million; transmission and distribution $3,556 million vs $3,333 million) and NEER $19,223 million (solar including solar plus battery storage $10,373 million vs $5,222 million; wind $2,885 million vs $2,955 million; customer supply - natural gas and oil production $1,175 million vs $280 million).
quarterly_data.figure: nine months ended September 30, 2026 capex $27,554 million (vs $19,328 million); FPL $8,322 million; NEER $19,223 million

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 segment results (10-Q): operating revenues $8,090 million versus $7,966 million, of which FPL $5,421 million (Q3 2025: $5,285 million) and NEER $2,516 million ($2,566 million); net income attributable to NEE was $1,620 million at FPL (vs $1,463 million) and $1,491 million at NEER (vs $1,275 million). Nine months: FPL operating revenues $14,588 million (vs $13,989 million) and NEER $7,360 million (vs $6,643 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 operating revenues $8,090 million; FPL $5,421 million; NEER $2,516 million

quarterly_data.signal: Pending combination with Dominion Energy (10-Q): in September 2026, certain approvals by Dominion Energy shareholders and NEE shareholders required for the pending business combination were obtained; NEE and Dominion Energy are working to complete the transaction in the second half of 2027, subject to conditions including approvals by the FERC, the NRC and the utility commissions in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina and clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act.
